what_it_is.prose: Data Patterns (India) Ltd is a vertically integrated defence and aerospace electronics solutions provider headquartered in Siruseri, Chennai. The company is one of the fastest-growing companies in the defence and aerospace electronics sector in India. Expertise includes radar and radar subsystems, electronic warfare (EW), rugged displays, fire control systems, launch vehicle check-outs, data buoys, satellite and launch vehicle electronics, and IFF systems. Data Patterns won a ₹27 crore DRDO order for next-generation wideband EW receivers configurable for naval, land and aerial platforms (LinkedIn/Raksha Anirveda). The company is also expanding electronic warfare capabilities with focus on naval ELINT systems and upgrades for India's MiG-29 fleet. Data Patterns is a vertically integrated OEM — handles design, development, manufacturing and testing in-house. Listed on NSE:DATAPATTNS and BSE:543428 with market cap ~₹25,891 Cr (Aug 2026).
